quarterly_data.signal: Operating facts in Schneider Electric's release on its World Economic Forum Global Lighthouse designations (the designation itself is not recorded): the El Paso (U.S.) site, which the company calls its largest manufacturing operation in the United States, produces customized low- and medium-voltage electrical solutions; amid rapid growth in data center demand it raised on-time delivery from 61% to 97%, reduced lead times by up to 35% and eliminated $43 million in backorders by deploying IoT and AI across its engineer-to-order value chain. The Beijing site (engineer-to-order and discrete manufacturing of SF6-free solutions) operated amid 30% business growth and increased insourcing.
quarterly_data.figure: El Paso on-time delivery 61% to 97%; lead times cut up to 35%; $43 million backorders eliminated; Beijing site 30% business growth
